reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified vulnerability. The sync path in request_manager.nim::checkColumnResponse (L176-194) only validates inclusion proof via verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof (L190), completely bypassing the length equality check in verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim L362-364). Columns with mismatched sidecar.column.len ≠ sidecar.kzg_commitments.len ≠ sidecar.kzg_proofs.len proceed to quarantine (L437), then block_processor.nim (L687) calls verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs directly without the length pre-check, passing mismatched arrays to C library verifyCellKzgProofBatch causing undefined behavior. The 01e property requirement (file: 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json, lines 78-93) explicitly mandates 'All input list lengths must be equal before batch verification proceeds' with assertion 'forall verify_batch(comms, indices, cells, proofs): len(comms) == len(indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs)'. Code violates this requirement. Severity calibrated to Medium per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE: Nimbus is minority client (<33% share), single malicious P2P packet can crash affected nodes (>5% threshold met), attack vector is external-reachable P2P.
